description:
Read the AUTHORITATIVE, COMPLETE field list of a model from the ACTUAL target database -
    every field with its type, label, relations, computed/related origin and storage - by
    introspecting the live Odoo registry over SSH. Unlike the static reference (28 core models),
    this covers EVERYTHING that db actually has: core + your custom modules + Studio (x_*) fields +
    installed OCA. Use THIS when you're writing/porting a module against a real database so you
    never invent or misspell a field. READ-ONLY (reads the registry, commits nothing).

    Per field: type, label, store, required, readonly; comodel (relational), relation_table/
    column1/column2 (many2many), inverse_field (one2many), related path, computed + depends,
    selection keys.
name: odoo_db_model_fields
